messages:
Ana Patel: Hey payroll — I just checked my March pay stub and it still shows CA state tax being withheld even though I updated my work address to OR in Workday on Feb 1. Did that not sync?
Payroll Bot: Hi Ana! Noted. Please open a Payline ticket with a screenshot of the stub and your Workday address page. Tag @Mike O'Connor and include 'retro state adjustment' in the subject.
Ana Patel: Filing the ticket now. Quick Q: do I need to submit any state-specific form (like OR IT-1) or is Workday enough?
Mike O'Connor: Workday usually covers residency changes, but OR has a reciprocity/nonresident nuance. If CA withholding already occurred for Feb/Mar we can do a retro refund on next cycle or issue a separate reimbursement. If you were a nonresident of CA for the pay periods, yes we can correct. No extra OR form is needed from payroll side — we rely on Workday address + employee attestation.
Julia Ramos: Adding: if you were physically remote in OR and didn't perform services in CA, we should also document your remote start date for tax audit purposes. Can you paste the date you moved and any calendar evidence?
Ana Patel: Moved 2026-02-03, calendar invite for team standups shows OR timezone timestamps. I'll attach those in Payline.
Eli Turner: Heads up — if you got >$x withheld in CA, issuing a retro refund may change tax withholding YTD; we typically run a YTD correction and share an updated paystub before processing. Mike/Payroll, estimate turnaround?
Mike O'Connor: Once Payline ticket has stub + Workday screenshot + move date, we triage within 2 business days. Correction processed in next payroll cycle (usually 1-2 cycles) and we flag for W-2 review. If a W-2 has already been generated for the year, we'll issue a W-2c.
Ana Patel: Cool, thanks. One more: will this affect benefits withholding or employer contributions?
Mike O'Connor: No change to benefit deductions. Only state tax withholding lines adjust. We'll confirm on the corrected stub.
Payroll Bot: Ticket created: PAY-8421 by Ana Patel. Assigned to Mike O'Connor. Please attach requested docs within 24 hours to avoid delaying the cycle. :white_check_mark:
Ana Patel: Attached stub and Workday screenshot. Thanks everyone!
